tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: Lists the five sample scenarios for the fictional Acme Mutual Insurance that run_check accepts, with their evidence ids. Demo data only.

tools.name: run_check
tools.description: Computes a Forge Orbital verdict for one of five fictional Acme Mutual Insurance scenarios and returns it with a signed decision record in the response. Read-only: nothing is stored, sent or changed. Optionally withdraw evidence ids to see how the verdict changes. Demo only: sample rules and sample

tools.name: verify_decision_record
tools.description: Verifies the Ed25519 signature of a Forge Orbital demo decision record against the published demo key id. Pass the full signed record object returned by run_check (this demo keeps nothing, so a record id alone cannot be looked up). Editing any field makes verification fail. Demo records only.

tools.name: replay_decision_record
tools.description: Replays a Forge Orbital demo decision: re-runs the deterministic engine on the same sample scenario (and any withdrawn evidence) and checks that the replay key and the decision match the record. Replayability is the point: the same inputs and engine version give the same decision. Reads nothing abou

tools.name: get_attestation_summary
tools.description: Verifies a Forge Orbital demo decision record against the pinned demo key and summarizes what it attests: signature status, the decision, whether the engine abstained, whether human review is required, and how many evidence items were used. Does not store the record. Demo records only.

tools.name: explain_verdict
tools.description: Explains, in plain English, why Forge Orbital reached the verdict in a demo decision record and what evidence a reviewer would need to change it. Read-only, stateless, demo data only.

tools.name: review_agent_workflow
tools.description: Run the Forge accountability engine evaluator and optimizer on synthetic examples or supplied labeled old/new outputs. For samples use payload={"sample_mode":"improved"}, or regression/changed_path. For a user-supplied comparison, translate only their supplied actions into this exact format: payload
